what: Inventory of the legacy MVP snapshot as it exists today. Everything listed here predates the freeze or is recorded below as a known violation. Anything NOT listed here that appears in the code is a new addition to a frozen store, and scripts/check-adr-006-freeze.mjs fails on it. Growing any of the three lists is allowed only as a reviewed, deliberate diff - that visibility is the entire point of this file.

knownViolations.why: A reminder-recipients model (name, relationship, phone, email, channel, per-recipient consent) was added straight into the MVP snapshot store on 2026-08-29, in good faith, by someone who did not know ADR-006 existed. It is a real violation of clause 5: the snapshot is currently the SOLE store for this domain data, including third-party consent records. It is recorded here rather than deleted because it is not in production yet and will be migrated, not reverted. Listing it keeps this baseline truthful instead of implying the store is clean.
knownViolations.removalCondition: Delete this entry when reminder recipients and their consent records live in normalized PostgreSQL under the tenant-scoped EmploymentCase aggregate and the web client reads them from there. The caredesk.mvp.reminder-recipients.v1 key and the MvpReminderRecipient interface must then be gone from apps/web/src/storage/mvp-storage.ts; this check fails if they are, while this entry still claims them.

exceptions.why: The National Insurance report table on the payroll screen produced per-month lines (employed, wage, rate, amount) that were discarded on save, so a filed report could not be reopened as filed. The lines are kept on MvpEmploymentExpense.nationalInsuranceMonths until a canonical home exists. It adds no new kind of input: it keeps figures the product already showed. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-17 (work plan item L).
exceptions.removalCondition: Delete this entry, the nationalInsuranceMonths field and the MvpNationalInsuranceReportMonth interface once National Insurance reports are stored in normalized PostgreSQL under the tenant-scoped EmploymentCase aggregate and the web client reads and writes them there (backlog R5-09). This check fails if the interface is gone while this entry still claims it.
